build_midashenglm_processor: build a MiDashengLMMultimodalProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and _processor for audio-language model processing
process_mm_data_audio: process multimodal audio data with MiDashengLMMultimodalProcessor.process_mm_data given input text and audio tensors
process_mm_data_async: process audio data asynchronously with MiDashengLMMultimodalProcessor.process_mm_data_async returning MultimodalProcessorOutput
configure_audio_special_tokens: configure audio special tokens including audio_bos, AUDIO, and audio_eos token IDs for MiDashengLM tokenizer
set_audio_length_from_features: set audio_length attribute on mm_items from ret audio_length or input_values tensor shape in process_mm_data_async
